marc:datafield.marc:subfield: Blue's Clues. Blue Learns Sign and Sound

Presents 4 episodes of the children's show with the blue puppy and her owner who teach learning skills through the puppy's adventures. in 'All kinds of signs', preschoolers play along with Steve to figure out where Blue wants to have her snack -- by following all kinds of signs -- from directional signs to American Sign Language! And in a second great game of Blue's Clues, kids continue to learn about signs by following maps to figure out where Blue wants to go. 'Stop, look and listen', lets preschoolers "view ordinary objects in extraordinary ways and listen closely to the sounds all around
